name: Holz, Eisen & Butter - Das Wirtshaus am Golfplatz
kurzbeschreibung:
**Wood, Iron & Butter – The Inn at the Golf Course in Tirol**

Discover the rustic charm of **Tirol** at **Das Wirtshaus am Golfplatz**, where traditional Tyrolean hospitality meets modern comfort. Nestled near the fairways of the **Innsbruck Golf Club**, this cozy inn invites you to savor hearty dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, crispy **Speckknödel**, and rich **Tiroler Gröstl**, all paired with the finest local **Butter** and craft beers.

After a round of golf, unwind in the warm glow of the **Holz**-fired stove, surrounded by **Eisen**-forged details that blend alpine simplicity with refined elegance. Whether you're here for a meal, a drink, or just the atmosphere, this is where **Tirol’s** soul comes alive—one bite, one sip, and one story at a time.
